labs.pi_title: Faculty Director; Berkman Professor of Entrepreneurial Legal Studies
labs.research_summary: Hewlett-funded program building the field of law and political economy through teaching, scholarship, fellowships and events for students and faculty around Boston.
labs.member_breakdown: 1 faculty director, 1 executive director, 1 program coordinator, 1 postdoctoral fellow, 1 academic fellow
labs.join_notes: The Student Fellowship (year-long, $4,000 grant, for Harvard 2L, 3L, SJD and PhD students) closed for 2026-27 and the next round is to be announced in spring 2027. The Academic Fellowship page says it is not currently seeking candidates.
labs.notes: R.H. Lossin is Executive Director; Angela Camacho-DeSousa is Program Coordinator; Corinne Blalock is postdoctoral fellow (2025-27); M. Sandhu is academic fellow (2025-27). Not counted: faculty affiliates, 7 student fellows for 2026-27 and one visiting scholar. The About page gives a contact email but it is hidden by the site's email protection, so it is not recorded.
